subject: Animation
title: Frozen Changes Everything
description: A micro-lesson that makes Frozen Changes Everything usable.

hook.text: In 2013, Frozen became a worldwide phenomenon that earned $1.28 billion and reshaped Disney.

buildup.text: The film's twist — true love was between sisters, not romantic — surprised audiences everywhere.

discovery.text: Let It Go became a global anthem. Frozen merchandise earned over a billion dollars each year.

twist.text: Disney had nearly made Elsa a villain. A late rewrite turned her into a sympathetic heroine.

climax.text: Frozen proved Disney could still create a global cultural event rivaling its greatest classics.

punchline.text: Two sisters and one song conquered the planet.

quiz.question: What creative change significantly impacted Frozen's success?
options: A late rewrite transformed Elsa from a villain into a sympathetic heroine
Casting a famous pop star for the soundtrack
